title: The AI Tool Wall Street Hates
full_monologue: **This AI tool is changing finance forever.** Wall Street is scrambling because it can predict market trends with uncanny accuracy. It’s not a stock app or a robot—this is a game-changer. It analyzes sentiment in real-time, from news to social media, giving traders an edge they can’t ignore. But here’s the catch: it’s open-source and free. That’s why they don’t want you to know. Are you ready to see the future of trading?
